title: Room for Error
coreMove: Pay for slack before pressure turns a small miss into forced action.
sourcePressure: Margin is not waste. It lets a plan survive volatility, mistakes, tight assumptions, and bad timing.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating room for error as pessimism or inefficiency.
